content.title: HCPSS Status
content.text: skip to main content Status reflects districtwide operations. If there is a change in operations only for a specific school, parents/guardians of that school will receive notification via email and text. Decisions regarding closings due to inclement weather will be made no later than 5:30 a.m. Two-hour delays will be called by 5:30 a.m. and reevaluated for closure no later than 7:30 a.m. Important Status Message March 26, 2026 Normal Operations Staff and students report in accordance with the HCPSS calendar. Within normal operations, due to weather conditions, outdoor activities may be brought inside, including lunch, recess, PE class, and/or after-school and community-use programs. View HCPSS Calendar Employee Work Groups All HCPSS employees may locate their bargaining unit or employee group by: Log in to Workday Select your photo icon at the upper right corner Select View Profle under your name Select Job from the left menu Select Organizations from the top menu Bargaining unit/employee group shows next to Job Profile Status Codes View All Status Code Options →
